name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.
